params.prompt: A real vertical aerial photograph taken from the same viewpoint as the first attached image, reframed tall: Mount Rainier huge and crisp in the upper third with its glaciers white against a deep blue sky, the rolling foothills and dark evergreen forest across the middle, and the whole small Pacific Northwest town (street grid, rooftops, tree-lined streets, fairgrounds and open fields) filling the lower half; the second attached image shows the real photographic look of the mountain's north face. A clear, dry, bright late-morning in early autumn: no haze, no fog, no blur, every rooftop sharp to the horizon. Photoreal, full-frame camera, 35 mm, f/8, like a high-quality photograph, never a 3D render or a map; no text of any kind, no titles, no overlays, no logos, no watermark, no people.
